fact: On 10 July 2024 the regulator Artec urged users to buy Starlink equipment and subscriptions only through Starlink's official website, which has offered a residential plan from 226,000 ariary a month since late June 2024.
title: L’Artec recommande aux usagers de passer uniquement par le site web de Starlink pour acheter leur matériel et souscrire à leur abonnement
